description: About Runnr.ai Runnr.ai is the AI platform for hospitality. We help hotels, holiday parks, hostels, and other accommodations talk to their guests across every channel they already use: WhatsApp, SMS, email, and the OTA inboxes (Booking.com, Expedia, Airbnb). Our AI answers guest questions, drives upsells, and plugs into the systems hotels rely on, like MEWS and other PMSs. We are a small, fast-moving team turning a guest communication tool into a complete guest management platform. If you want to shape an AI product in a real industry and see your work reach guests and hoteliers quickly, this is a good place to do it. The role We are looking for a Product Manager to own features from end to end: shaping what we build, preparing the work for engineering, launching it well, and driving adoption once it ships. This is a hybrid product and product-marketing role. You will sit at the intersection of product, engineering and marketing, and you will be as comfortable writing a crisp user story for a developer as you are writing the announcement that tells customers why a feature matters. We offer you real ownership. You will run features end to end and see the impact quickly. You will have the chance to shape an AI product in an industry that is only starting to adopt it. Responsibilities Own the backlog. Prioritize day-to-day work, turn ideas into build-ready user stories and acceptance criteria, and talk to customers to shape the roadmap. Know the product. Get hands-on with our AI features so you can help shape them and explain them simply to a non-technical audience. Take features to market. Develop the story and terminology for each release, own the go-to-market plan and the brief for our agency, and coordinate supporting content like How-to videos and support articles (with external help where it makes sense). Communicate launches. Keep the company aligned internally, and share updates with customers and partners through the right channels: Slack, Canny, and announcement emails or newsletters in HubSpot. Drive adoption. Maintain a customer / feature adoption matrix and a continuous strategy to grow usage beyond launch. Team up with customer success on rollout and run customer betas that connect the product team to real customer feedback. Work across the company. Partner with founders, engineering, marketing, sales, customer success, and support to get features into customers' hands. Competencies Must have 2 to 4 years of experience in a product role, ideally at another startup. Experience working on a product with a meaningful visual component to its user experience: you understand how look and feel shape the way people use a product. Proven prioritization skills: you can decide what matters most when everything feels urgent. Affinity with data and LLM models: you are comfortable reasoning about AI-driven products and want to understand what is happening under the hood. Strong written communication: much of this role is writing clearly for very different audiences (developers, customers, marketers). Nice to have Experience creating content such as short videos, screen recordings, or support articles. B2B SaaS or hospitality-tech experience. Comfort with ambiguity and a self-starter attitude that fits an early-stage startup.

description: About WorkIndia: WorkIndia is India's largest blue- and grey-collar hiring platform, built with a clear purpose: to provide meaningful livelihoods to 23.7 crore blue-collar individuals across India. WorkIndia helps millions of job seekers connect with employers across the country. On the employer side, WorkIndia serves tens of thousands of businesses every month, enabling them to discover, evaluate, and hire relevant candidates at scale. About the Role: We're looking for a Group Product Manager to lead the Centre of Excellence — WorkIndia's central matchmaking engine. You'll own product strategy and outcomes across the end-to-end hiring funnel, translating company strategy into a roadmap that improves experience and retention on both sides of the marketplace, alongside driving candidate growth. You will lead a team and work closely with the Head of Product, business leads across the org, and Engineering/Data partners whose infrastructure your roadmap depends on. This role requires strong product judgment on a genuinely hard, two-sided problem — what looks like a candidate-side fix is often the difference between an employer renewing or churning. About the Centre of Excellence (CoE): The CoE owns WorkIndia's central matchmaking engine — the capability that drives world-class matching by solving for the end-to-end hiring funnel. This manifests as improved experience and retention on both sides of the marketplace. Additionally, CoE carries the responsibility for candidate supply — acquisition and reactivation. What You'll Do: Strategic Ownership Own and evolve the CoE product strategy in service of WorkIndia's matchmaking goals Translate company goals into a clear CoE roadmap Balance near-term KPI delivery with longer-term platform investments that unlock them User Thinking & Product Judgment Build deep fluency in consumer behaviour and the drivers of activation and retention Ground every roadmap decision in real candidate and employer outcomes, not proxy metrics Business & Product Leadership Own outcomes, not features: growth, retention, and long-term matchmaking capability Manage and grow a cross-functional team spanning product management and analytics Partner closely with marketing and engineering on channel and delivery strategy Represent CoE in cross-functional forums where outcomes are shared with other business units Execution & Systems Thinking Drive roadmap sequencing across near-term fixes and longer-term platform bets Convert repeated operational patterns into scalable product systems rather than one-off fixes Push for systems that hold up at significant scale, in coordination with platform teams Data & Decision Making Own the CoE metrics tree and use data to prioritise across the charter Push the team to instrument outcome metrics over vanity metrics Team & Reporting: Reports to : Head of Product Directly manages : A team spanning product management and analytics Key partners : Marketing, Engineering & Data, other product business units, Design What We're Looking For: 9+ years of Product Management experience, with a track record of owning large, metric-accountable product areas Demonstrated ability to drive both growth and retention/matching-quality metrics Strong systems thinking and comfort resolving ambiguity Deep data fluency Experience managing a cross-functional team Marketplace or two-sided consumer product experience strongly preferred Why Join WorkIndia? Impact: Be a part of a mission-driven company that impacts millions of lives daily Growth: High ownership environment where your initiatives directly shape the company culture Location: Work out of our vibrant office in HSR Layout, the startup hub of Bengaluru

description: Wil jij als Business Analist werken aan uitdagende projecten voor vooruitstrevende klanten en onze Business, IT & Data-cel versterken? Solliciteer nu en ontdek jouw mogelijkheden als Employeneur! Over de rol: Stel je voor: het is maandag. Overdag werk je aan een uitdagend project bij een klant in de energiesector. Je analyseert hun bedrijfsprocessen en gebruikt jouw kennis van BPMN en requirements engineering om grip te krijgen op hun digitale transformatie. ’s Middags bel je kort met een collega die tegen een probleem aanloopt bij zijn opdracht. Dankzij jouw ervaring met data governance en procesontwerp kun je hem snel verder helpen. Dat is de kracht van samenwerken binnen onze Business, IT & Data-cel: kennis delen, elkaar versterken. En dan op donderdag, is het tijd voor de kwartaal meeting. Samen met je collega’s van de cel bespreek je de voortgang. Wat gaat goed? Waar liggen kansen? Onder het genot van een hapje en een drankje ontstaan de beste ideeën voor de verdere ontwikkeling van onze cel. Ondertussen voel je je geen externe consultant, maar echt onderdeel van een hecht team dat groeit en bouwt. Een week eerder zat je nog bij ons op kantoor voor een training. Je koos zelf: wordt het BISL? Agile? DAMA DM-BOK? Of toch een BCS Business Analysis-certificering? Het is jouw opleidingsbudget – jij bepaalt waar je in groeit. Want bij TMC draait het om jou, jouw ambities en jouw ontwikkeling. Wat ga je inhoudelijk doen? Je gaat aan de slag bij uitdagende en vernieuwende projecten bij onze opdrachtgevers! Samen gaan we voor jou op zoek naar een passende opdracht bij een werkgever waar je altijd al graag had willen werken. Er wordt veel tijd besteed aan wat jij wilt en wat jij belangrijk vindt. Bij TMC ben echt onderdeel van het team. Zo zorgen we ervoor dat je altijd op een geschikte positie terecht komt. Je gaat aan de slag bij uitdagende en vernieuwende projecten bij onze opdrachtgevers! Hoe ziet jouw werk eruit? Je analyseert bedrijfsprocessen en vertaalt deze naar concrete verbeterkansen; Je haalt requirements op bij stakeholders en vertaalt deze naar heldere User Stories en Use Cases; Je werkt met modellen zoals BPMN en gebruikt tooling om processen te visualiseren; Je implementeert oplossingen die direct impact maken bij onze relaties; Je helpt collega's verder door jouw kennis te delen en samen te sparren over complexe vraagstukken; Je neemt actief deel aan onze Business, IT en Data cel, inclusief onze kwartaal meetings, trainingen en andere evenementen. Wie ben jij? Een afgeronde HBO- of WO-opleiding. Een natuurlijke gave om te schakelen tussen Business en IT. Ondernemerschap en nieuwsgierigheid: jij zoekt altijd naar de ‘waarom’ achter een probleem. Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en analytisch vermogen. Ervaring met procesmodellering, requirements engineering en Agile Wie zijn wij? Bij TMC in Noord-Oost Nederland geloven we in de kracht van ondernemende mensen. Mensen die niet alleen hun vak verstaan, maar ook willen bouwen – aan organisaties, aan elkaar, en aan zichzelf. Onze missie? Een hecht team vormen van professionals die bruggen slaan tussen bedrijfsprocessen en informatietechnologie. Geen standaardoplossingen, maar maatwerk door mensen met lef, visie en eigenaarschap. In dit team sta jij niet onderaan een hiërarchie, maar naast collega’s die net als jij geloven in transparantie, autonomie en samenwerking. We delen kennis, stimuleren elkaars groei en vieren successen samen. Of dat nu op kantoor is, tijdens een kwartaalmeeting met een borrel, of op een projectlocatie waar jij impact maakt. En Het Mooiste? Je Staat Er Nooit Alleen Voor. Ons Employeneurship Model Is Uniek En Vanuit Dit Model Bieden Wij Jou: Je krijgt een vast contract, zodat je met vertrouwen kunt bouwen aan de toekomst; Je ontvangt een aantrekkelijk salaris (€4500 tot €6500), afgestemd op jouw kennis en ervaring; Je deelt mee in de winst, op basis van jouw persoonlijke prestaties – tot wel 45%; Je krijgt €2.200 opleidingsbudget per jaar, dat jij naar eigen inzicht mag besteden: van coaching tot vaktrainingen zoals Agile, BISL of DAMA DM-BOK; Je maakt deel uit van onze Business, IT & Data-cel, met ervaren en ondernemende collega’s; Je krijgt ruimte voor je eigen ideeën, via ons TMC Lab waar dromen realiteit worden; Je werkt aan projecten die ertoe doen, binnen de energietransitie, zorg, overheid, techniek en publieke dienstverlening.
title: Business Analist | Bouw mee aan de toekomst van TMC!

Important Information Davy is an equal opportunities employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. description: Our mission is to provide innovative services critical to society, unlocking a cleaner, better and more profitable future. Working towards this goal, Volue has become a leading technology supplier and enabler of the green transition, helping energy companies simplify and optimize everyday operations. We are now looking for Product Manager who can help us to continuously improve Volue’s ability to provide value to customers in line with the Volue mission. The Product Manager owns discovery, strategy, and outcomes for Volue's Data & Forecasts (D&F) portfolio – data, forecasts, and analytics spanning every time horizon, from balancing and intraday markets through day-ahead to long-term energy price forecasting. Success in this role means a deep, evidenced understanding of customer needs, a product strategy and roadmap clearly aligned with D&F's broader commercial strategy, and close collaboration with engineering, design, sales, and marketing to ship outcomes that strengthen Volue's market position. The role sits within a growing PM function that is moving from knowledge held by individuals to structured, systems-based product practice. What you will be doing to make a difference: Develop a deep understanding of customers and the energy markets landscape – from balancing and trading through to long-term planning – including workflows, processes, and pain points; own product discovery and translate insights into product outcomes. Define product-specific strategy and business model, aligned with D&F's broader strategy and market opportunities across all time horizons. Maintain and prioritise the product roadmap based on customer discovery, commercial input, and technical feasibility. Ensure tight alignment with other products and business areas within Volue, collaborating extensively with Product Owners and other Product Managers across product lines, and with stakeholders in development, consulting, sales, and other functions to deliver a cohesive product offering and strategy. Own Go-To-Market alongside Sales and Marketing – plan launches, enable the field, close feedback loops from the market, and act as the market voice for the product, driving thought leadership and positioning Volue as a market leader in the segment. Monitor the competitive landscape and industry trends to keep products relevant and differentiated. Own and maintain key product assets for internal stakeholders – including the product roadmap, standard agreements and pricing, product factsheets, and presentations. Contribute to structured, systems-based ways of working within the D&F product team, reducing reliance on individual knowledge and coordination. What you need to succeed: Bachelor's or Master's degree in a technical or commercial field, or equivalent relevant experience. 5+ years of experience working on software or data products as a product manager, product owner, consultant, or industry expert. Solid understanding of modern product discovery and product management practices. Language skills: fluent English required; additional European languages an advantage. Nice to have Proven experience in the energy, power markets, or trading industry. Comfort working with quantitative and forecasting concepts, and translating them into commercial and customer value. Personal skills Structured and self-starting, comfortable owning ambiguous problems. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills. Strong commercial understanding. Team-motivator with the ability to cooperate with a wide range of people and teams across functions and disciplines. Willing to travel as required by the role. The position reports to VP Product and cooperates closely with D&F Product Management team, Engineering and tech leads within the relevant product area, Design (UX/Product Design), Sales, Consulting, and Marketing.
